finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the input string 'a' contains shell metacharacters or commands
finding.assumptions: The function 'main' is used to execute shell commands based on the input string 'a'.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the input string 'a' is too long, causing the recursive calls to exceed the stack limit
finding.assumptions: The recursive calls modify the input string 'a' and pass it to other recursive calls.
